name: Recursive byte closure and bindings
summary: Exactly 8 recursive files, no nested directory, no __pycache__. Six payloads bound by PAYLOAD_HASHES.json; inventory bound by the seal; implementation SHA256 bound by the seal. Nested unbound file, mutated bound byte and injected __pycache__ each rejected in temporary copies only; real candidate byte-identical after every test.

name: V3-to-V4 change isolation
summary: AST diff over 38 top-level definitions: 36 identical, 2 changed beyond schema literals (real_archive_canary, verify_environment), 2 added (sign_code_sha256, describe_numerical_backend), 5 changed only in a schema version string literal, 0 removed. Zero changes outside the permitted surface. All 25 numerical/estimand core definitions and all 30 core constants unchanged.

name: Canary dispatch stability
summary: Independent reconstruction over 6 dispatches: 392 units, shapes [392,96] and [1,96], blob verified against the pinned manifest. Sign digests identical across all 6 and equal to both declared constants; candidate --mode preflight PASS on all 6. Raw float digests form 4 distinct groups, so the gate is non-vacuous. Measured noise 1.2018e-13, min |value| 4.0888e-07: 409x the required margin and 3.40e6x the noise, with 0 entries inside the noise band. Canary opens only chats/100K/12/chat.json; no probing questions, gold, ranking or metric.

name: B1 no-replace finalization
summary: Clean synthetic finalization emits the three CSVs and the manifest. Each of the 4 destinations and each of the 4 .tmp paths blocks before any byte changes, with sentinel bytes intact. Partial derived set blocks rather than being repaired. Rerun after success blocks. Commit is exclusive: temporary via open('x'), destination via os.link, which refuses an existing destination and leaves it intact.

name: B2 exact frozen-gold metric recomputation
summary: Every metric is recomputed from canonical retrieved IDs and frozen gold. 17 tamper classes all block: fractional/ANY/ALL tampering in both directions, structural ALL@3 zero forced to one, changed and reordered IDs, duplicate, non-string, non-canonical and Boolean IDs, NaN/inf/out-of-range metrics, gold-cardinality inconsistency, unsorted/negative/oversized/Boolean distances.

name: B3 exact control and trial replication
summary: Every signed-permutation seed and trial must carry exactly the Native ordered top-three IDs and exact distances. ID-membership, ID-order and distance divergence each block even with metrics equal. Missing and duplicate cells block on row count. Trial-varying payload under fixed priority blocks. Native-vs-control question-level metric equality remains as a redundant final guard.

name: Aggregation and output schema
summary: 320 trial rows per eligible question; 16 question-seed rows, 4 question-method rows and 4 aggregate rows per question set; all four methods present with the correct seed counts. Aggregates reproduce an independently recomputed equal-question-weighting mean exactly. Trials are deterministic replication identities, never independent statistical units. Manifest records console_outcomes_emitted=false and interpretation_authorized=false.

name: Active bug hunt
summary: Sign-code path cannot launder a representation change: the independent baseline reproduces the sealed canary and all 7 realistic perturbations (latent/mixed seed, latent dim, sublinear_tf, stop words, word and char n-gram range) change the digest. CANARY_SIGN_MARGIN cannot be trivially satisfied: degenerate archives are refused by the fit preconditions and a constant matrix clears the margin but fails the digest. Backend provenance reads only OPENBLAS_CORETYPE; AUTH_HMAC_ENV is read only inside verify_run_authorization, never returned and never referenced by any output writer. Only the exact V4 checkpoint is accepted; V3 schema replay and cross-provenance substitution both block.

name: Authorization fail-closed
summary: With the HMAC environment absent, 11 invalid fixtures were rejected and none accepted. The sealed key commitment is the literal PENDING_HEAD_RESEARCHER_PREREGISTRATION, so verification fails at HEAD RESEARCHER AUTHORITY KEY NOT SEALED before any secret is read. A temp-copy seal carrying a syntactically valid commitment fails at KEY MISSING. No valid production authorization was constructed.
